verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench ships web-based software tools (Document Driver, Capital and Liquidation Calculators), so asking whether it offers a machine-readable API spec is a fair question. However, no evidence shows any public API or OpenAPI spec. Probes of all standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned HTTP 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
